plugins.name: media-os
plugins.description: Routed multi-agent media production — 40 skills + 13 routed modes + 7 specialist agents + 5 lifecycle hooks + 3 CLIs (moprobe, moqc, mosafe). A SessionStart gateway (using-media-os) forces every media intent through the router, which dispatches to the right specialist (architect, probe, qc, hdr, encoder, live, delivery) under shared Iron Laws (probe-first, mosafe-wrap, quality-gate, OSI-open AI-license filter). Covers FFmpeg complete, OBS, GStreamer/MediaMTX, broadcast IP (NDI/DeckLink/Dolby Vision/HDR10+), control protocols (MIDI/OSC/DMX/PTZ), system audio routing, VFX, computer vision, WebRTC, and commercial-safe open-source AI media (upscale, interpolate, denoise, generate, matte, depth, OCR, tag, lipsync).
